He owned and operated Inglewood’s Credit Auto Center, a used-car business registered in 1970, and remained directly involved in sales decades later. Away from the dealership, he became a sustained presence in major Pacific offshore races.

long_biography.plain_text:
Automobile retailing defined Fred Claus Preiss’s working life. Credit Auto Center was registered in Inglewood in 1970 with Preiss as president and agent. A published appellate opinion later identified him as the dealership’s owner and sole shareholder and described his continuing hands-on role in vehicle sales.

Preiss also built an enduring reputation in Pacific offshore sailing. Official Transpac programmes list him as an owner-skipper across successive campaigns and credit him with a custom design and build. Contemporary reports followed his crews in races to Hawaii, Mexico and around Catalina, including a 1981 sweep of line honours, class and overall honours in the Puerto Vallarta race.
